chunks: A book has come to me regarding the Imamate, signed with the original handwriting: 'The book of Abū al-Shadākh regarding the Imamate'. It is around fifty pages. I showed it to my father, but he did not recognize the man.

key_terms.الْإِمَامَةِ: Imamate (the doctrine of religious and political leadership)
key_terms.وَرَقَةً: Pages (specifically paper leaves in this context)

ai.seo_question: Who was Abū al-Shadākh and what is known about his book on Imamate?
ai.summary: This entry from Kitab al-Du'afa identifies a figure named Abū al-Shadākh. The author received a book attributed to him concerning the Imamate, which was approximately fifty pages long. He showed this book to his father, who was unable to recognize Abū al-Shadākh as a known figure.
